target: UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF, AArch64 PCI graphical guest, one vCPU, isolated disposable guest disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-tos-distro-std-8181-current-2026-11-12.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --quick --probe-demo-tos-distro-std
result: partial: standard distro packaging stops at the intentional ARM64 ArmBoot guard
verified: The exact current ISO booted and initialized the graphical terminal under the UTM-bundled QEMU/HVF profile.
The stock MakeHome and MakeTOS module sets loaded; TOS_HDS was CD; TOSDistro and the MakeStdDistro wrapper loaded and began execution.
The prior unresolved Drive failure is absent; the probe proceeds into source-tree preparation before reaching the boot-image helper.
The guest raises uncaught exception 0x00746f6f426d7241 (ASCII ArmBoot) at BootDVDIns. The ARM64 bridge intentionally rejects legacy BIOS boot-image generation until an EFI-capable path exists.
scope_note: The probe used an isolated disposable guest disk and did not touch a host or removable volume. It does not produce or boot an ARM64 UEFI distro image, and it does not indicate a RedSea filesystem failure.
